What is MeowTrail?

MeowTrail is a cat-themed logic puzzle by Oakever Games. Based on the classic Akari (Light Up) puzzle, you place light bulbs on a grid to illuminate all white cells while following numbered clues and avoiding bulb conflicts.

How to Play

  1. Place bulbs on white cells
  2. Each bulb lights up its entire row and column
  3. Black cells block light
  4. Numbered cells show how many adjacent bulbs they need
  5. No two bulbs can see each other
